subject: Quick pulse: MPA owners, available time‑slots and timeline priorities
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@tessera.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@tessera.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick pulse: MPA owners, available time‑slots and timeline priorities

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Really appreciated the candid conversation about Tessera's evaluation needs and priority signals for Q4. As promised, I attached a first draft Mutual Action Plan (MPA) that lays out proposed owners, target milestones, and a few week‑by‑week time slots for evaluation access and performance checkpoints.

High level asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm the internal point people for each row in the attached MPA (champion, IT contact, and procurement)?
- Which of these 2‑week windows best matches your timeline: Oct 18–31, Nov 1–14, or Nov 15–28?
- Is priority still high for a production decision by end of November, or has timing slipped?

Suggested next steps: 
1) You confirm owners + pick a window in the MPA (quick edit will do).
2) We schedule a 30‑minute kickoff to provision the trial environment and run the smoke test (I can do Oct 19 or Nov 2).
3) Procurement and legal loop in for any initial questions — happy to provide the evaluation SOW and a short procurement checklist.

Attachments: Tessera_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA draft, editable), redwood-eval-setup-checklist.pdf (setup & access checklist).

If it's easier, ping me with the owners and I can update the doc and re-share. Thanks — looking forward to locking dates so we can get you a fully instrumented trial.

Warmly,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(h) 415‑555‑0197 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

--

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick pulse: MPA owners, available time‑slots and timeline priorities

Hey Hannah — thanks for the MPA and the checklist. I skimmed the plan this AM and it looks sensible. A few quick notes: 

- I'll own the champion column and coordinate internal stakeholders.
- IT point person will likely be Mina Patel (I copied procurement; I'll confirm the IT contact once I loop her in).
- Procurement asked for the evaluation SOW and any standard terms you expect for an evaluation.

Can you share the SOW and a short summary of any data retention / access controls we should expect during the trial? Also, Oct 18–31 looks best on our side but I need to confirm Mina's availability. I'll get back to you by EOW with owners and a confirmed window.

Appreciate the follow up — will aim to lock owners by Friday.

Best,
Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
Tessera AI

Subject: Re: Quick pulse: MPA owners, available time‑slots and timeline priorities — final nudge + support offer

Jordan — Stephanie here on Hannah's team. Wanted to drop a quick note to offer a slightly different path if timelines are tight: we can frontload a scoped performance pack that requires only the champion + one IT contact for an accelerated 1‑week smoke test, then expand into the full MPA if results look good.

If Tessera is still targeting a decision by end of November, we should aim to start smoke tests by Oct 25 latest. If that's unrealistic, tell us which week in November works and we'll rebase the MPA.

Also: if procurement needs an editable SOW and a prefilled purchase order template to speed approvals, I can send those today and open a DocuSign envelope so your legal team can review without back‑and‑forth.

If you can confirm owners (or at least the champion + procurement contact) by Wed 14 Oct, I'll get the SOW and DocuSign ready. Otherwise I'll check back next week.

Appreciate it — happy to make this lower lift.

— Stephanie Nguyen
